titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, CBC News
mainText: Andrew Tate and his brother were arrested in Miami; the United Kingdom seeks their extradition.
Ukrainian drones struck warehouses and other sites across Russia, resulting in 9 deaths and over 60 wounded.
Two U.S. military personnel were killed and one was reported missing following an attack in Jordan attributed to Iran.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, BBC News
mainText: The United States denied Iranian claims that it hit civilian infrastructure in recent strikes.
Josh Kerr of Britain set a new world record in the mile.
